history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V46 workload, representation, width, job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, binary-provenance profile, publication ruling, process classification, memory diagnostic, and aggregate attribution counter. It changes no scored row or execution boundary. It versions the diagnostic per-opcode runtime-operation histogram added by #1016 as schema 1 within the existing schema-17 tier-attribution sidecar, and re-pins the shared zig-js comparison runner. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, diagnostic schema, process policy, or publication change needs its own version.
change: Adds the schema-v1 contract for the sparse per-bytecode runtime-operation histogram emitted by the shared zig-js comparison runner, requires every count to be a nonnegative integer, reconciles each cumulative histogram exactly to runtime_operation_calls, and rejects per-opcode counter regression across phase boundaries. The histogram is diagnostic and does not enter scored timing, phase equivalence, allocation replay, performance ratios, stability decisions, or publication acceptance.

runtime_operation_diagnostics.reconciliation: Every sparse per-bytecode count is a nonnegative integer, cumulative counts cannot regress across phase boundaries, and their exact sum equals execution.runtime_operation_calls.
runtime_operation_diagnostics.publication_boundary: The histogram is diagnostic and does not enter scored timing, phase equivalence, allocation replay, performance ratios, stability decisions, or publication acceptance.

exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: V47 preserves every V46 timing, efficiency, cleanliness, checksum, serial-child, process-classification, provenance, mixed-tier allocation-replay, and memory-diagnostic gate. The schema-17 tier-attribution sidecar gains a schema-v1 diagnostic per-opcode runtime-operation histogram contract, validated against its existing aggregate counter.

context_lifecycle_integration.publication_boundary: V47 changes only the shared runner hash. Lifecycle scenarios, options, checksums, phase and finalizer reconciliation, plateau policy, measured-boundary occupancy, and evidence ruling are unchanged.

no_jit_integration.publication_boundary: V47 changes only the shared runner hash. Required-bytecode and no-native modes, logical work, checksums, scored attribution, quickening contracts, publication duration, and exact-parent requirements are unchanged.

string_indexing_integration.publication_boundary: V47 changes only the shared runner hash. Every string representation, width, job count, checksum, required-bytecode boundary, scored attribution value, measured-boundary occupancy rule, and exact allocation replay remains unchanged.
